name: Barbell Clean Pull
steps: Stand with a barbell over your midfoot, hinge with bent knees and a flat back, and take a shoulder-width overhand hook grip.
Push firmly through your feet to lift the bar close past your knees while maintaining a consistent back angle.
Extend your hips, knees, and ankles explosively as the bar reaches your upper thighs, finishing with a strong vertical shrug.
Lower the bar under control back to the floor without dropping your posture.
tips: Keep your arms straight throughout the entire pull rather than bending your elbows early.
Drive vertically upward through your legs and traps instead of throwing your shoulders backward.
